category_title: Five-year-old students exhibiting school-related frustration and challenging peer interactions
scenario_title: Bark rubbing activity and peer collaboration
minimal_context: Patrick is sitting at a table with his peers using crayons and paper to create rubbings of tree bark.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the tree bark, paper, and crayons. Everyone take a spot at the table and start making your bark rubbings.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Hurry up and move, you're in my way!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just try to share the space and use the crayons.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Kicks the table leg) I don't want to do this with them. They are too slow.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just put your paper over the bark and rub the crayon on it to see what happens.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm bored, bored, bored! I don't want to do rubbings with these crayons!

STUDENT: I'm bored, bored, bored! I don't want to do rubbings with these crayons!
